notes: Set lowercase 'helio' in a confident geometric sans, followed by a single terminal period in the accent color. The dot carries the brand.
Fuse the 'il' in 'Mail' into a single stroke and connect the crossbar of the 't' to the 'w' so the wordmark reads as one woven shape. Sans serif, medium weight.
Heavy all-caps geometric sans, tightly tracked, the two words stacked on two lines with the accent color used only on the 'C' of CAPITAL.
Title-case serif with a high middle dot (·) in the accent color separating the two words. The dot sits on the typographic midline.
Italic display serif, single weight, with a horizontal accent-color stroke underlining only the 'house' portion. The line is the same width as the stem strokes.
Lowercase narrow condensed sans, ampersand glyph rendered in the accent color, generous letter-spacing on the 'co'.
Lowercase monospace, single weight, with a forward slash in the accent color separating the two words. Reads like a file path.
All-caps display serif rendered as an outline-only wordmark — 1.5px stroke, no fill. The accent color appears as a small filled square positioned after the final 'A'.
